Hi Alex / Sophie —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Acme's ingestion / moderation requirements and the latency targets you mentioned. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Recap: main goals are predictable token-cost per inference, sub-200ms 95th-percentile latency for single-turn queries, and support for on-prem private deployment for regulated models.
- Next step: 60-min technical demo + architecture deep dive with our solutions engineer to validate performance and integration approach.

I know schedules are tight — below are three windows this week that work on our side. If one works, please reply with A/B/C and I'll send a confirmed calendar invite. If none, let me know two windows next week and we can prioritize.

A) Wed 10/07 9:00-10:00 PT
B) Wed 10/07 11:30-12:30 PT
C) Thu 10/08 14:00-15:00 PT

Attachment: 20261005-redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (short agenda + data/access checklist)

If it's helpful, I'll loop Dylan (SE) into the confirmed invite for any perf tuning discussion.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
